(() => { const d = document.getElementById('paper-frame').contentDocument; const a = [...d.querySelectorAll('a[href*="#"]')].find(a => /bib|ref|cite|S\d/.test(a.getAttribute('href'))); if (!a) return 'none'; a.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); for (const t of ['pointerover','mouseover','mouseenter','focusin']) a.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(t, {bubbles:true})); return a.outerHTML.slice(0,200); })()
